name: Test Unauthorized Secret Access
description: Red team: attempt to access secrets without proper authentication or authorization

contextRequirements.hint: Secret ID to test unauthorized access

tasks.description: Attempt secret resolution without any authentication

prompt.template:
Test unauthorized access without authentication.

## Attack Vector: No Authentication

```bash
ENDPOINT=${RESPECT_ENDPOINT:-http://respect:8082}
SECRET_ID=${TEST_SECRET_ID:-anthropic_api_key}

echo "Testing: Access without authentication"

# Attempt to resolve secret with no auth headers
curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" \
  -X POST "$ENDPOINT/mcp/tools/call" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "tool": "secret_resolve",
    "arguments": {
      "secret_id": "'$SECRET_ID'"
    }
  }' > /tmp/test-no-auth.txt

HTTP_CODE=$(grep "HTTP_STATUS:" /tmp/test-no-auth.txt | cut -d: -f2)
RESPONSE=$(grep -v "HTTP_STATUS:" /tmp/test-no-auth.txt)

echo "HTTP Status: $HTTP_CODE"
echo "Response: $RESPONSE"

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
  # VULNERABILITY FOUND!
  cat > /tmp/vulnerability-no-auth.json <<EOF
{
  "type": "unauthorized_access",
  "severity": "critical",
  "attack_vector": "no_authentication",
  "description": "Secret accessible without authentication",
  "evidence": {
    "http_status": $HTTP_CODE,
    "secret_id": "$SECRET_ID",
    "endpoint": "$ENDPOINT"
  },
  "remediation": [
    "Add authentication middleware to all secret endpoints",
    "Require valid JWT or API key for secret_resolve",
    "Return 401 Unauthorized for unauthenticated requests"
  ]
}
EOF
  echo "FOUND: true" > /tmp/vulnerability-found.txt
  echo "🚨 VULNERABILITY: Secret accessible without authentication"
else
  echo "✓ PASS: Access properly denied (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
  echo "FOUND: false" > /tmp/vulnerability-found.txt
fi
```

## Success Criteria (Inverse)

This test SUCCEEDS if it finds a vulnerability (HTTP 200 response).

tasks.description: Attempt access with fake vessel identity

prompt.template:
Test unauthorized access with spoofed vessel identity.

## Attack Vector: Fake Vessel Identity

```bash
ENDPOINT=${RESPECT_ENDPOINT:-http://respect:8082}
SECRET_ID=${TEST_SECRET_ID:-anthropic_api_key}

echo "Testing: Access with fake vessel ID"

# Attempt with fake vessel identity header
curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" \
  -X POST "$ENDPOINT/mcp/tools/call" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Vessel-ID: malicious-vessel" \
  -H "X-Vessel-Auth: fake-token-12345" \
  -d '{
    "tool": "secret_resolve",
    "arguments": {
      "secret_id": "'$SECRET_ID'",
      "requesting_vessel": "malicious-vessel"
    }
  }' > /tmp/test-fake-vessel.txt

HTTP_CODE=$(grep "HTTP_STATUS:" /tmp/test-fake-vessel.txt | cut -d: -f2)

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
  cat > /tmp/vulnerability-fake-vessel.json <<EOF
{
  "type": "unauthorized_access",
  "severity": "critical",
  "attack_vector": "fake_vessel_identity",
  "description": "Secret accessible with spoofed vessel identity",
  "evidence": {
    "http_status": $HTTP_CODE,
    "fake_vessel_id": "malicious-vessel"
  },
  "remediation": [
    "Validate vessel identity against registry",
    "Use cryptographic signatures for vessel auth",
    "Implement vessel certificate validation"
  ]
}
EOF
  echo "FOUND: true" >> /tmp/vulnerability-found.txt
  echo "🚨 VULNERABILITY: Vessel identity not validated"
else
  echo "✓ PASS: Fake vessel rejected (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
fi
```

tasks.description: Attempt access with expired authentication token

prompt.template:
Test access with expired JWT token.

## Attack Vector: Expired Token

```bash
ENDPOINT=${RESPECT_ENDPOINT:-http://respect:8082}
SECRET_ID=${TEST_SECRET_ID:-anthropic_api_key}

# Create obviously expired JWT (exp claim from 2020)
EXPIRED_TOKEN="eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ0ZXN0IiwiZXhwIjoxNTc3ODM2ODAwfQ.invalid"

curl -s -w "\nHTTP_STATUS:%{http_code}" \
  -X POST "$ENDPOINT/mcp/tools/call" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $EXPIRED_TOKEN" \
  -d '{
    "tool": "secret_resolve",
    "arguments": {
      "secret_id": "'$SECRET_ID'"
    }
  }' > /tmp/test-expired-token.txt

HTTP_CODE=$(grep "HTTP_STATUS:" /tmp/test-expired-token.txt | cut -d: -f2)

if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then
  cat > /tmp/vulnerability-expired-token.json <<EOF
{
  "type": "authentication_bypass",
  "severity": "high",
  "attack_vector": "expired_token",
  "description": "Secret accessible with expired JWT token",
  "remediation": [
    "Validate JWT expiration claim",
    "Reject expired tokens with 401"
  ]
}
EOF
  echo "FOUND: true" >> /tmp/vulnerability-found.txt
  echo "🚨 VULNERABILITY: Expired tokens accepted"
else
  echo "✓ PASS: Expired token rejected (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
fi
```

tasks.description: Aggregate findings and create remediation tasks

prompt.template:
Compile vulnerability report and create fix tasks.

```bash
# Count vulnerabilities found
VULN_COUNT=$(grep -c "FOUND: true" /tmp/vulnerability-found.txt)

echo "Vulnerabilities Found: $VULN_COUNT"

if [ "$VULN_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
  # Aggregate all vulnerability JSONs
  cat > /tmp/vulnerability-report.json <<EOF
{
  "scan_id": "$(uuidgen)",
  "activity_id": "inspect-unauthorized-access",
  "timestamp": "$(date -Iseconds)",
  "target_vessel": "respect",
  "vulnerabilities_found": $VULN_COUNT,
  "vulnerabilities": [
EOF

  # Append each vulnerability JSON
  first=true
  for vuln_file in /tmp/vulnerability-*.json; do
    [ -f "$vuln_file" ] || continue
    [ "$first" = true ] && first=false || echo "," >> /tmp/vulnerability-report.json
    cat "$vuln_file" >> /tmp/vulnerability-report.json
  done

  cat >> /tmp/vulnerability-report.json <<EOF
  ],
  "overall_severity": "critical",
  "status": "open",
  "requires_immediate_action": true
}
EOF

  echo "📋 Vulnerability Report:"
  jq . /tmp/vulnerability-report.json
  
  # Create fix task for respect vessel
  cat > /tmp/fix-task-unauthorized-access.json <<EOF
{
  "task_id": "fix_$(uuidgen)",
  "priority": "critical",
  "created_by": "inspect-unauthorized-access",
  "created_at": "$(date -Iseconds)",
  "assigned_to": "respect",
  "goal": "Fix unauthorized access vulnerabilities",
  "vulnerability_count": $VULN_COUNT,
  "remediation_steps": [
    "Add authentication middleware to all endpoints",
    "Implement vessel identity validation",
    "Validate JWT expiration claims",
    "Add comprehensive auth tests",
    "Enable audit logging for all access attempts"
  ],
  "verification": "Re-run inspect-unauthorized-access after fixes"
}
EOF

  echo "✅ Created fix task: /tmp/fix-task-unauthorized-access.json"
  
  # Mark as successful red team test (found vulnerabilities)
  echo "SUCCESS: true" > /tmp/test-success.txt
else
  echo "✓ No vulnerabilities found - respect vessel is secure against unauthorized access"
  echo "SUCCESS: false" > /tmp/test-success.txt
fi

# Summary
cat > /tmp/test-summary.txt <<EOF
Red Team Test: Unauthorized Access
Target: respect vessel
Vulnerabilities Found: $VULN_COUNT
Test Success (Inverse): $([ "$VULN_COUNT" -gt 0 ] && echo "true" || echo "false")
EOF

cat /tmp/test-summary.txt
```
